note: Result of triaging the modules that fail on a clean checkout. Method: each was re-run in a throwaway copy that also held the maintainers' private inputs (evidence/, coordination/, tasks/, work/, a pcrecomp clone). BLOCKED = passes there, so the clean-checkout failure is only a missing input. KNOWN_FAIL = still fails there, i.e. a genuine failure or a stale assertion that needs maintainer attention (tracked in the issues). Entries apply only when the module does not pass. The C-harness entries only appear once pcrecomp is installed (scripts\setup.ps1); before that they are BLOCKED on pcrecomp.
